snippet.title: Against the Storm - Nightwatchers DLC Trailer | Dark Fantasy/Roguelite City Builder
snippet.description:
It’s time to sink your fangs into Against the Storm with its latest DLC, Nightwatchers, releasing on July 31st!

Bats join the struggle in Against the Storm, bringing their own strengths, weaknesses, and desires. Settle challenging new biomes, explore new building options, and make unlikely allies, all in service of the Scorched Queen!

➤ STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725110/Against_the_Storm__Nightwatchers
➤ GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/against_the_storm_nightwatchers
➤ EPIC: https://store.epicgames.com/p/against-the-storm--nightwatchers
